name: scheduler
description: A background job automation tool that registers, updates, lists, and manages recurring or time-delayed tasks powered by isolated skill routines. Use whenever the user requests periodic operations (such as daily backups or hourly reports) or future time-based triggers. Use this to run asynchronous workflows reliably and autonomously outside the active conversation.

job_id.description: Scheduled task ID; required for update, delete, pause, and resume.

task.description: Task to execute; required when creating.

start_at.description: First execution time, such as now, in 2h, or an ISO 8601 date/time. Default now.

repeat.description: Recurrence pattern, such as every 30m, daily at 09:00, or monthly.

repeat_count.description: Total number of executions. Omit for unlimited repetition.

timezone.description: Timezone for scheduled times. Default user/system timezone.

rules: Omit repeat for one-time tasks. start_at=now with repeat runs immediately, then repeats. repeat_count limits total executions.
